title: PLUTO: Pediatric Lipid-redUction Trial of rOsuvastatin

sections.abstract:
The primary objective of this study is to determine the efficacy of once-daily rosuvastatin in reducing LDL-C in children and adolescents aged 10-17 years with HeFH from baseline (Day 0) to the end of the 12-week double-blind treatment period.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change in Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) From Baseline (Day 0) to the End of the 12-week Double-blind Treatment Phase. timeframe=12 weeks. Rosuva 5=-38.5 (±11.38); Rosuva 10=-44.4 (±12.15); Rosuva 20=-50.2 (±13.3)
